title: Centralize platform facts in a leaf layer and gate raw platform reads
summary: OS-specific facts (command locators, venv layout, IPC kind, env vars, shells) were re-invented inline at ~900 sites because the OS abstraction covered only actions, not facts. A frozen platform-facts descriptor layer plus a boundary test now centralizes nouns while the driver layer keeps verbs.
reusable_steps: OS-specific facts (command locators, venv layout, IPC kind, env vars, shells) were re-invented inline at ~900 sites because the OS abstraction covered only actions, not facts
A frozen platform-facts descriptor layer plus a boundary test now centralizes nouns while the driver layer keeps verbs
expected_outcome: Rule: platform facts (command locators, executable suffixes, venv layout, home env vars, shells, IPC transport, filesystem/symlink/process/media semantics) live in a frozen descriptor module (libs/core/platform-facts.ts) reached via injectable getPlatformFacts(p); OS actions stay in the OSDriver layer. New code must not read process.platform/os.platform() directly — a boundary test holds an explicit shrinking allowlist. Platform predicates must resolve the platform at call time so tests can stub process.platform via defineProperty. Prefer declarative seam/provider matching against facts over inline platform branches; keep name-based platforms matching for genuinely OS-bound implementations.
